_note: What the validation stack does and does not machine-verify. Surfaced to the user beside the issue list so 'no issues found' is never read as 'legally compliant'. Reviewed and maintained by the supervising advocate, not by engineering.

not_machine_verified.statement: The duty payable is now estimated from the rate table and the values on the intake form, but rates are held for 6 states only, and whether duty was actually paid is not verified -- no amount paid is collected.
Whether registration is required is now decided from the instrument type and its term. Whether registration was actually effected, and within the 4-month window under S.23, is not verified.
Whether the person signing is authorised - by board resolution, power of attorney or partnership deed - is not verified.
Whether the price, term, liability cap or notice period is commercially reasonable for this transaction is not assessed.
The truth of the party details, addresses, identifiers and recited background is taken from the intake form and is not independently verified.
Whether the allocation of risk is appropriate to the parties' relative bargaining position is a matter of legal judgement and is not assessed.
Clauses are checked against statute, not against the current state of judicial interpretation; the case-law corpus is a partial seed.

not_machine_verified.area: Tax, exchange control and sector regulation
not_machine_verified.statement: Each document type carries a checklist of statutory matters -- TDS, GST, FEMA, competition, BIS and similar -- that are surfaced to the drafter as a notice but are not evaluated against the facts of the transaction.
Clause text is drafted from statute but has not necessarily been signed off by an advocate. The proportion of this document's clauses that carry a sign-off is reported under coverage.clause_review.

TERMS_OF_SERVICE.statement: Acknowledgement and resolution timelines for the grievance officer are not checked against the IT Rules 2021.

EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.statement: Obligations that switch on at a headcount or wage threshold - POSH, PF, ESI, gratuity - are not evaluated, because headcount is not collected.
EMPLOYMENT_CONTRACT.statutory_reference: POSH Act, 2013 - S.4; EPF Act, 1952 - S.1(3)
